html:
Agents, below you will find the details about patch 1.9.5
 
 
▣ 3 New Character Added
 
Ms. Marvel (Kamala Khan), Thor (Jane Foster), and Carnage just joined the fight for the future!
 
 
 ※ Carnage is only available via the monthly biometric selector available in the store.
 
 Due to the new Characters, new achievements and new team bonuses have been added.
 
 
▣ 3 New Uniforms
 
 3 New Uniforms added for Green Goblin, Luke Cage, and Star-Lord.
 

* You will be able to check new uniforms in Marvel Universe and Uniform Room.
* New uniforms will be available for a discounted price during a certain period.
 
 
▣ New 6★ Skills
 
 Green Goblin (Classic), Vision, and Hawkeye now have their 6★ Skills.

 

 1. Green Goblin (Classic): Aerial Charge
 2. Vision (including Uniforms): Dimensional Attack
 3. Hawkeye (including Uniforms): Evasive Shot
 
 
▣ Character Revamp
 
The following characters have been revamped to improve their combat effectiveness.
 1. Wasp
- "Encouragement" applies to all characters in your team.
- “Encouragement” debuff applies to all enemies on the screen.
 
 2. Hawkeye (including Uniform)
  - "Arrow Barrage" Each arrow has its own attack range
  - "Sure Shot" Animation changes based on distance between Hawkeye and enemy
  - "Piercing Arrow" Now has tracking
 
 3. Ronan
  - "Tip the Scales" skill range increased
- "Law Enforcer” skill range increased
- “Tip the Scales”, “Universal Weapon”, “Arbitration”, “Law Enforcer” skill damage increased
- Ronan’s Physical/Energy Defense and HP increased.
 
 4. Yondu
  - "Leap Kick" Skll range increased
  - "Arrow Call" Skill animation improved.
 
 5. Winter Soldier
  - "Sharpshooter" now has tracking
  - "Explosive Sabotage" Skill range and animation decreased
 
 6. Jessica Jones
  - “Coming for You”, “Bum-rush”, “Smack Down”, “Powerhouse” Skill damage increased
 
 7. Spider-Man (Miles Morales)
  - "Back Bite" Animation changes based on distance between Miles and Enemy
 
 8. Nebula
  - Normal Attack range has been increased
  - “Vicious Spree" Skill range increased
- "Elegant Kick" Skill range increased and she throws more lightning bolts (up to 3)
  - "Dagger Dance" Skill range increased
 
 9. Green Goblin (excluding Uniform)
  - "Bag of Tricks" hits every enemies in range
  - "Bombing Run" each pumpkin has its own attack range
 
 10. Rocket Raccoon (including Uniform)
  - "I’ve got a plan" Heal effect activation now heals at the correct time.
 
 11. Drax(All-New, All-Different)
  - "Cry for Blood" Taunts enemies in range
 
 12. Captain America (Avengers: Age of Ultron)
  - "Ready for Battle" Taunts enemies in range
 
 13. Iron Fist (New Avengers)
- "K’un Lun Focus" Taunts enemies in range
 
 14. Red Skull
- "Strategist" applies to all characters in your team.
 
 15. Elsa Bloodstone
- "Bloodstone Training”, “Filled with Hate”, and “Nowhere to Hide” skill damage increased
 
 
▣ Team Managing Menu & Gear Upgrade Menu Improvement
 
 1. Team Managing Menu Improvement – Hero List
   You can expand characters list with new sorting function
 

 
 2. Team Managing Menu Improvement – Team Editing
You can now drag & drop to join or remove your team mate.
 
 
 3. Gear Upgrade Menu Improvement
  Now you can check Minimum & Maximum status of each bonus options.
 

 
 
▣ Battle World Improvement
 
 You can check who you will deal with in battle world and you can also refresh the list to find the best opponent!
 
 1. Looking for Opponent
  You will see how many points you will get & could lose based on your opponent.
 

 
 2. Opponent Change
   If you decide to change your opponent, you will spend a certain portion of the entrance fee.
   You will also have the limit to change your opponent
   * Limit of Search Again and Entrance may vary.
 
▣ Timeline Battle Improvement
 
 1. For more exciting games, the matching system in Timeline Battle has been improved
    You will be matched with random players and you are also able to regresh the search list.
 

 
 * Searching for a new opponent requires certain amount of gold.
 
 2. If your match is not finished within time limit, the player with the most HP left wins.
 
 
 
▣ Other Improvements
 

1. Monthly Biometrics item added
  - You will get 300 Crystals immediately, and you can select 20 Biometrics every day for 30 days
2. Fixed an issue with Loki’s Illusions in Villain Siege where they stopped attacking when hit by piercing attacks
3. Fixed an issue with Vision’s skill "Density Shift" last attack not hitting correctly. (including Uniform)
. Fixed an issue with Vision’s skill “Microwave Pulse” not hitting correctly. (including Uniform)
5. Fixed an issue with Luke Cage’s Skill ”Dempsey Roll”, “Sweet Christmas”, and “Tactical Offense” not hitting correctly.
6. Fixed an issue with Sif’s skill “Sudden Stab”, “Attack Egde”, and “For Honor!” not hitting correctly.
7. Fixed an issue with Winter Soldier’s Skill “Suppressing Fire” and “Bionic Combat” not hitting correctly.
8. Fixed an issue with Jessica Jones’s skill “Coming for You” and “Smack Down” not hitting correctly.
9. Fixed an issue with Nebula’s Skill “Dagger Dance” not hitting correctly
10. Fixed an issue with Groot’s Skill “Spore” following him when moving to a new area of a mission
11. Fixed an issue with Captain Marvel’s Skill “Radiant Form” that reset her activated passive Skill “Absorb Energy”.
12. Fixed an issue with Sif’s Passive Skill “Warrior Defense” barrier effect does not disappearing after skill activation.
13. Fixed an issue with Captain Marvel’s Passive Skill “Absorb Energy” resets after she move to next stage.
14. Fixed an issue with Lady Loki’s voice not changing
15. Fixed an issue with Exit button does not work when all characters have been defeated while Dimension Rift found.
16. Flash sale rotation time changes from 30 minutes to 15 minutes.
17. Fixed an issue with Jessica Jones cannot hit opponent after “Bum-rush” and “Powerhouse”
18. Fixed an issue with Yondu’s Skill “Leap Kick” that does not hit enemy correctly
19. Energy, Gold and Crystal Shop have been divided
  - Tab Crystal Icon or “+” Button on top to access recharge shop.
20. Fixed an issue with Ant-Man’s Skill “Pym Discs” hitting enemies incorrectly.
